name: L10 PanoLab three-producer pixel-unseen temporal router panel
question: Does the unchanged router transfer beyond the Nzau-only confirmation to one pixel-unseen target from each of three Panoramax capture producers?

selection.anchor_eligibility: Reference and query anchors must be a direct target-building pair from the frozen candidate ledger, use distinct collections, have strict explicit-zero pose projection, and not overlap any prior router item or excluded target way.
selection.ordering: For each producer stratum in the fixed order, walk the already frozen direct-candidate ledger order and select the first anchor pair whose exact reciprocal reference-next and query-prev/query-next all remain in the anchor collections, link reciprocally, pass strict explicit-zero projection, and do not overlap prior items.
selection.metadata_failure_policy: A candidate failing linked metadata is recorded and skipped before any selected pixel exists. Once a metadata-valid candidate is selected for a stratum, no pixel-driven substitution or resampling is allowed.
selection.pixel_boundary: All ten anchors and neighbours for selected rows remain undownloaded and human/model unseen at freeze. The first five earlier federated-source targets are excluded because their anchors were previously materialized and reviewed.

materialization.download: Download exactly fifteen selected HD panoramas through .jpg.part files, atomically replace finals, and remove partials in a finally path.
materialization.image_contract: Each decoded image must exactly match its already frozen strict projection sensor dimensions and remain a full 2:1 equirectangular panorama.
materialization.overwrite: Refuse an existing selection, manifest, or output root.

claim_boundary.allowed: A metadata-frozen, target-way/item-disjoint, pixel-unseen Development source spanning three capture-producer strata for the unchanged same-provider router.
not_allowed: provider-disjoint, open-world, conformal, FDR-controlled, independent, or deployment confirmation
portal visibility or ownership from metadata/projection alone
access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, or safety
